findings.claim: OpenTable（Booking 旗下）於 2026-04-20 宣布收購加拿大訂位平台 Libro，Libro 維持獨立品牌。

findings.claim: Booking.com 於 2026-04 確認訂房資料遭未授權第三方存取（姓名、聯絡方式、訂房細節），稱未涉及付款資料、已重設訂位 PIN。
findings.source: BleepingComputer：New Booking.com data breach forces reservation PIN resets

findings.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q 揭露：2026-10 歐盟執委會對 Booking.com 啟動 DSA 調查；2026-07 FTC 員工告知 Priceline 擬建議提起訴訟；2026-04 義大利競爭暨消費者局啟動調查；西班牙 CNMC 罰款上訴中、已認列約 4.72 億美元負債。
2026-02 公司作為原告與對方達成和解，預計 2026 Q1 取得約 9,000 萬美元收益。
findings.excerpt: In February 2026, the Company entered into favorable settlement agreements to resolve litigation matters in which it was a plaintiff, for which it expects to receive a benefit of approximately $90 million in the first quarter of 2026, upon completion of various conditions.
On February 18, 2026, the Company announced a twenty-five-for-one forward stock split of the Company's common stock.

note: 查無證券詐欺集體訴訟、SEC 調查、重編；有歐洲/FTC 監管案與資料外洩。
